title: Create a Student class
instruction: Create a `Student` class with an `__init__` method that takes `name` and `grade`. Add an `introduce()` method that **returns** the string `"Hi, I'm [name] and I'm in grade [grade]."`.
test_suite:
def test_introduce_returns_correct_string():
    s = exercise.Student("Alice", 10)
    result = s.introduce()
    assert result == "Hi, I'm Alice and I'm in grade 10.", f"Expected 'Hi, I'm Alice and I'm in grade 10.', got {result!r}"

def test_introduce_different_student():
    s = exercise.Student("Bob", 7)
    result = s.introduce()
    assert result == "Hi, I'm Bob and I'm in grade 7.", f"Expected 'Hi, I'm Bob and I'm in grade 7.', got {result!r}"

def test_stores_name_and_grade():
    s = exercise.Student("Charlie", 12)
    assert s.name == "Charlie", f"Expected name 'Charlie', got {s.name!r}"
    assert s.grade == 12, f"Expected grade 12, got {s.grade}"

def test_grade_can_be_zero():
    s = exercise.Student("Test", 0)
    assert s.grade == 0, f"Expected grade 0, got {s.grade}"

title: Add __str__ to Student
instruction: Add a `__str__` method to the `Student` class so that `str(student)` returns `"Student: [name], Grade: [grade]"`.
test_suite:
def test_str_returns_formatted_string():
    s = exercise.Student("Bob", 11)
    result = str(s)
    assert result == "Student: Bob, Grade: 11", f"Expected 'Student: Bob, Grade: 11', got {result!r}"

def test_str_different_student():
    s = exercise.Student("Alice", 9)
    result = str(s)
    assert result == "Student: Alice, Grade: 9", f"Expected 'Student: Alice, Grade: 9', got {result!r}"

def test_introduce_still_works():
    s = exercise.Student("Charlie", 10)
    assert s.introduce() == "Hi, I'm Charlie and I'm in grade 10.", f"introduce() should still work after adding __str__"

def test_str_single_digit_grade():
    s = exercise.Student("Diana", 5)
    result = str(s)
    assert result == "Student: Diana, Grade: 5", f"Expected 'Student: Diana, Grade: 5', got {result!r}"

title: Inherit from Student
instruction: Create a `GraduateStudent` class that inherits from `Student`. It should accept an additional `thesis_topic` parameter in `__init__` and override `introduce()` to **return** `"Hi, I'm [name], grade [grade]. My thesis is on [thesis_topic]."`.
test_suite:
def test_graduate_student_introduce():
    gs = exercise.GraduateStudent("Diana", 12, "AI in Healthcare")
    result = gs.introduce()
    assert result == "Hi, I'm Diana, grade 12. My thesis is on AI in Healthcare.", f"Expected 'Hi, I'm Diana, grade 12. My thesis is on AI in Healthcare.', got {result!r}"

def test_graduate_student_different_topic():
    gs = exercise.GraduateStudent("Eve", 11, "Quantum Computing")
    result = gs.introduce()
    assert "Quantum Computing" in result, f"Expected thesis topic 'Quantum Computing' in {result!r}"

def test_student_still_works():
    s = exercise.Student("Frank", 9)
    result = s.introduce()
    assert result == "Hi, I'm Frank, grade 9.", f"Expected 'Hi, I'm Frank, grade 9.', got {result!r}"

def test_graduate_student_inherits_attributes():
    gs = exercise.GraduateStudent("Grace", 10, "Robotics")
    assert gs.name == "Grace", f"Expected name 'Grace', got {gs.name!r}"
    assert gs.grade == 10, f"Expected grade 10, got {gs.grade}"
    assert gs.thesis_topic == "Robotics", f"Expected thesis_topic 'Robotics', got {gs.thesis_topic!r}"

def test_graduate_student_is_instance_of_student():
    gs = exercise.GraduateStudent("Henry", 12, "Bioinformatics")
    assert isinstance(gs, exercise.Student), "GraduateStudent should inherit from Student"
